content_html:
watched #ShubhMangalZyadaSaavdhan : MAN!!! is there any movie genere that Ayushman cant do with ease!!!!!

story and execution wise its a simple routine love story where the lead pair falls in love and their parents doesnt approve their love….in the second half one of the lead pair enters the house to impress their partners family and finally the family approvs their love in typical “Jaaa Simran jaaa….jii le apni zindagi” style!!! but the only difference being the homo-sexuality of the lead pair!!!!

The writer and director Hitesh Kewalya thought of keeping the whole Homo-sexuality angle very simple without any melodrama or over the top message dialogues!!! nor he has ensured to make the film an out and out family entertainer with comedy (like Dream Girl)….so the film neither becomes a message oriented one nor a comedy entertainer but falls some where in between!!!!

All the artists were at their best with good charaterizations which made the whole homo-sexuality part (which is still considered as a Taboo) look very simple and watchable even for “FAMILY” audience!!!!

dont expect much from the movie and you will like it…..All the Ayushman fans (including me) who thump their chests with the choice of his script selection have one more movie to brag about!!!!
